description: Tiled floor: square tiles in a grid, offset (half-tile) or checker pattern with grout gaps, random height and tint, cut to the floor edges, on a grout bed. Pivot at the centre of the base; the tile tops are at the bed thickness + tile thickness. Pieces: tile_floor_tiles (tile_light; tile_dark for the checker's dark squares), tile_floor_grout (grout). Every piece is a closed box.

tile_size.desc: tile edge length including the gap (m)

tile_pts.note: one point per (clipped) tile; checker's dark tiles go to point group dark

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
